name: Відкритий напад (4)
description: The discovered attack remains one of the most powerful weapons in chess. By moving a piece and revealing an attack, you create a situation where multiple opposing pieces come under pressure. A discovered attack is particularly effective because you essentially set up two threats simultaneously. As the front piece moves, it opens the attack of a rook, queen, or bishop behind it.

examples.text: By advancing the e-pawn, White opens an important diagonal for the white queen. Black cannot avoid losing material.
The white knight jumps forward, leading to excellent coordination among the white pieces. White wins the exchange.
